explication: Finance Skills is a collection of agent-facing financial research, analysis, and workflow skills, with bundled OpenCLI readers for TradingView and Hyperliquid. The primary flow is an agent using a skill to obtain or analyze information and return a research result; the README documents the skill capabilities and external services. The graph also shows the sampled reader entry points and helpers. Many skill instructions and other plugin sources were not sampled, so those branches are represented at skill-directory level and their internal calls are not inferred.
